note: Black Hills National Forest campground on FSR 291 about 5 miles south of Deerfield Reservoir, in an open meadow beside Ditch Creek; the sites were rebuilt in 2022 for modern RVs. The Ditch Creek OHV trailhead is directly across the road and OHV riders camp here with their machines. No drinking water. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov facility, catalog and rates read: 13 FCFS non-electric gravel sites (spurs 50-80 ft), vault toilets, no drinking water; $24 concession season May 15-Sep 30 (stored $22 -> 24), free off-season with an unplowed road. FCFS and 14-night limit confirmed. Sits opposite the Ditch Creek OHV trailhead (flag, not a drop). rec.gov tags every site Riverfront - re-audit lead only. Pin fine.
flags: OHV: the campground faces the Ditch Creek OHV trailhead ('directly opposite the road from the campground. Please keep your OHV trailer and machines within your campsite') - a general FS campground with an OHV side, not a staging area; caveat in the note, no drop.
FEES: stored $22 -> $24 (rec.gov Walk In rate 2026 and 2027). Second vehicle $6/night (ExplorUS notice) not written - fee key uncertain.
FACILITIES: potable_water false written (FS 'Potable water is not available'; rec.gov 'Drinking water is NOT available'); the old note's 'temporary water outage' is superseded.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (not changed): rec.gov's catalog tags all 13 sites 'Proximity to Water: Riverfront'. Ditch Creek is a narrow stream (well under 30 m), so creekside at most; on imagery 2026-11-21 the stream is not visible near the pads (open meadow loop, spruce to the west; stored evidence 'small Ditch Creek with no open-bank pads') - not waterfront kept.

OPERATOR/PHONE: rec.gov names concessionaire ExplorUS, contact (661) 702-1420; the FS page names Forest Recreation Management, Inc. (2022). Stored (605) 343-1567 is rec.gov's facility phone; the off-season contact is the forest office 605.673.9200. No change proposed.
